newsitem.title: USA: Ford to idle Oakville plant next week.
newsitem.headline: Ford to idle Oakville plant next week.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said it plans to idle its Oakville, Ontario, minivan plant next week for a facilities change related to a fourth door to be offered on the vehicle during the 1999 model year.
The shutdown will affect 3,000 hourly workers who normally produce 6,000 Ford Windstar minivans a week.
Ford said truck plants that are working overtime this week include: Edison, N.J., Kansas City Truck, Kentucky Truck, Norfolk, Va., Twin Cities and St. Louis.
General Motors Corp said it has scheduled overtime next week at its Wilmington, Del., car plant that produces the Chevrolet Malibu, and at its Janesville, Wis., medium-duty truck plant.
GM has said four of its car plants are idled as a result of a parts plant strike.
Chrysler Corp said its Jefferson-North sport/utility plant in Detroit will operate overtime next week. The Newark, Del., plant will not operate due to model changeover.
In Ontario, Windsor Assembly Plant and the Pillette facility will operate overtime. The Bramalea plant will be down for a model changeover.
